      "title": "Fallback credential filter uses impossible type 'calendar'",

      "file": "packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts",

      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Team destination calendars are dropped when organizer has no destination calendar",

All team host calendars are discarded, so collective hosts will not receive calendar events."

      "severity": "medium",

      "title": "Organization slug condition inverted",

findings.title: TypeError when destinationCalendar is missing or empty
findings.body: mainHostDestinationCalendar is undefined when evt.destinationCalendar is null or an empty array. The code then accesses .integration, which throws a TypeError. Several handlers now pass [] when no calendar exists, so creating a booking with a Google Meet location can crash before any event is created. Use optional chaining and handle the empty-array case.

findings.title: Fallback credential filter uses impossible type 'calendar'
findings.body: When destinationCalendar is missing or empty, the fallback selects this.calendarCredentials.filter(cred => cred.type === 'calendar'). The credentials collected here are types such as google_calendar or office365_calendar and are filtered by endsWith('_calendar'), so an exact 'calendar' type will not exist. The fallback therefore never creates a traditional calendar event.

findings.body: evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to null when neither eventType nor organizer has a calendar. The later collective-only code uses evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars), which is a no-op on null. All team host calendars are discarded, so collective hosts will not receive calendar events.

findings.title: loadUsers can return undefined instead of an empty array
findings.body: The new loadUsers returns users.length ? users : eventType.users, while the old code returned eventType.users || []. If hosts is empty and eventType.users is undefined, loadUsers resolves to undefined; downstream code that expects an array, such as users.length or users[0], can throw.

findings.title: Organization slug condition inverted
findings.body: The slug spread changed from including slug when IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is false to including it when true. This reverses the previous behavior: organizations created while billing is disabled will have no slug, while billing-enabled organizations get a slug immediately, likely breaking organization creation or the billing flow.
